## Daily Schedule of Activities

### Monday: Microclimate models
- Introduction to mechanistic niche models: concepts and differences with correlative models
- Microclimate fundamentals: radiation, air and soil temperature, wind and humidity
- The NicheMapR package: microclimate estimation at different spatial scales
- Practical session: generating and visualising microclimatic profiles

### Tuesday: The animal model
- Biophysics of heat exchange: conduction, convection, radiation, evaporation and metabolism
- Operative body temperature and its environmental and morphological determinants
- The ectotherm module of NicheMapR: implementation and parameterisation
- Practical session: simulating body temperatures and activity periods

### Wednesday: DEB models and free work
- (Very brief) introduction to Dynamic Energy Budget (DEB) theory: assimilation, maintenance, growth and reproduction
- Integration of DEB with the animal model: predicting the life cycle under different environmental conditions
- Practical session (optional): fitting and interpreting DEB models in ectotherms
- Practical session: addressing questions, reviewing concepts and working on participants’ personal projects
